The magical reactions are spiraling completely out of control, and the house itself might not survive the aftermath! The Guild Master experiences a sudden and massive surge in height and muscle, growing into a room-sized giantess right before their eyes. Meanwhile, Lei’s own reaction forces her to flee into another room to contain her rapidly expanding F anatomy.
But containment is impossible. What starts as a heavy, floor-dragging appendage quickly escalates into a room-filling, wall-breaking disaster.
